product_summary: Website krishiviman.com (live) presents 'Krishi Viman' as a DGCA type-certified agricultural spraying drone brand, marketed by 'WOW Go Green' (agritech startup). Real products listed on site: KV10+ and KV10++ agricultural spray drones (10 L liquid tank, 4 micro/nano spray nozzles, 3-4 m spray width, 15-20 min flight, 16000 mAh 44.4 V autopilot battery, terrain/obstacle radar, flow meter, FPV camera, max payload 10-12 kg / 27.65 kg stated for KV10++), plus accessories: brushed water pump, extended rod nozzles, FPV camera. Also offered: drone pilot training (DGCA-approved RTPO), spraying services, surveillance/mapping/thermal imaging services. The linked legal entity UAVGARAGE PRIVATE LIMITED operates uavgarage.com — an e-commerce distributor of drone components (motors, ESCs, flight controllers, GPS/GNSS, propellers, carbon fibre, batteries, gimbals, cameras, FPV gear, frames) and resells third-party agri drones (WOW Go Green Krishi Viman KV-10 at INR 650,000, Airbots Surya Shakti 15L, EFT E610P/E616P kits, Thanos Syena-H10/H10i, NAI Agro Drone MK1). So the actual product mix is: (a) own-brand agri spray UAVs, (b) drone spare parts/components trading, (c) drone services and training.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — brand owner/assembler of Krishi Viman agri drones (DGCA type certificate claimed) combined with a clear component-distribution/trading business (UAVGarage e-commerce, resale of EFT, Airbots, Thanos, NAI third-party drones). Strong trader signs: multi-brand catalogue, 'Sell On UAVGarage' marketplace, 'End-to-end Drone Component Sourcing', imported brands (T-Motor, Molicel, Amass, Pixhawk, Gremsy, Herelink, DFRobot).
comment: HS 8806.23 declared. 8806.23 covers remotely controlled UAVs with MTOW >250 g to <=7 kg. The documented Krishi Viman agri spray drones are far heavier: 10 L tank, 10-12 kg payload, 16000 mAh 44.4 V pack, 27.65 kg max payload stated for KV10++ — i.e. realistically 8806.24 (>7 kg to <=25 kg) or 8806.25 (>25 kg to <=150 kg) depending on the certified MTOW. The site does not publish a certified MTOW figure, so the exact 6-digit line cannot be pinned down from public data: 8806.24 is the best-supported line, 8806.25 possible for the KV10++ variant. Verdict: partial — the heading 8806 is correct (unmanned aircraft, remotely controlled), the subheading weight class is understated. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company stays in the base, code corrected to the factual weight class. Industry label 'Авиастроение и транспорт' is broadly right but imprecise — this is agritech/agri-machinery (UAV crop spraying), not aerospace manufacturing or transport/logistics. Missing from the declaration: (1) drone spare parts and components (motors, ESCs, flight controllers, GPS, propellers, carbon fibre, batteries, gimbals, cameras, FPV) which are a large share of the UAVGarage catalogue and would fall under 8807.30 / 8507 (batteries) / 8544 (wiring) / 6815 (carbon fibre articles) rather than 8806; (2) agricultural spraying appliances 8424.41/8424.49 if spray assemblies are sold separately; (3) services and training (no HS code — services, not goods). Everything above is taken from the public websites krishiviman.com and uavgarage.com; no customs line, shipping bill or B-L record was checked in this task, therefore the product range is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level — the products are real and listed, but no export/import line corroborates them here. No CIN, PAN, GSTIN or revenue figures were researched or asserted (out of scope for this role); PAN and state fields in the input are empty and remain null.
